$comment: Machine-readable summary of the Charness License for people and AI agents deciding whether a licence is needed and what it costs. LICENSE is the binding text; the repository's tests keep the two in agreement.

organizationLicence.rule: Find the band of R and the band of H separately and pay the higher price.

modelsTrainedOnCharness.summary: one licence covers Charness and the models trained on it: a model trained on purpose on Charness is published only with this licence and used under Charness's rules; only a group that sells or offers such a model, or a general model it trained, needs its organization licence for that, whatever Part 1 allows; the exact terms are LICENSE 2.5 and 3.3

oem.rule: The supplier pays the greater of its organization licence fee and the OEM amount, never their sum.

steps: Check Part 1 and sections 3.3–3.5. If your use is free under Part 1, you sell or offer to others no model you trained on Charness (section 3.3; using one is covered like using Charness), and you neither embed Charness in a product nor offer it to others as a hosted, managed or resold service, you need nothing and send no order; running Charness on your own computers or servers for your own work is neither. Embedding it in a product, or offering it as a service, needs its signed agreement first (sections 3.4–3.5), even at $0.
Work out the price: your band (section 3.1) from the latest month-end figures, and any discount (section 3.6).

Send an order to charnesshub@gmail.com with: the organization's legal name and country, the organization at the top of its group (section 4.10), its R and H bands, the term (1, 2 or 3 years), the discounts wanted, and the e-mail for the invoice. If you sell or offer a model trained on Charness (section 3.3), say so.
Pay the invoice you get back.
Keep the paid invoice or its receipt: either is your licence and its proof. There is no key and nothing to install.
